folders.mappingConcern: Business-functional motivation grouping for patient identity and demographics.
Establishing and validating patient identity and supporting evidence.

Patient identity lookup, controlled disclosure and external identity enquiries.
Identity exceptions, risk, quality review and oversight.
Business-functional motivation grouping for provider and workforce management.
Registering and maintaining provider and practitioner identity.
Qualifications, registration, credential verification and professional standing.
Provider organisational relationships, roles, locations and service affiliations.
Maintaining professional profiles and provider contact details.
Provider onboarding, change, suspension and lifecycle administration.
Business-functional motivation grouping for consent and information sharing.
Obtaining, recording, changing, renewing and withdrawing consent.
Managing consent purpose, duration, restrictions and sharing preferences.
Determining whether consent and relevant authority apply to an activity.
Consent by representatives and verification of delegated authority.
Presenting consent history, notices, discussions and change notifications.
Consent handling for emergency access and exceptional situations.
Business-functional motivation grouping for terminology and reference data.
Maintaining code systems, concepts, ValueSets and terminology definitions.
Validating, comparing and mapping terminology and concepts.
Governed terminology publication, versioning and release lifecycle.
Maintaining governed reference values and reference datasets.
Reference data ownership, verification, quality and stewardship.
Business-functional motivation grouping for provider directory.
Searching and discovering providers, services and locations.
Publishing and controlling provider directory visibility.
Updating and managing directory entries.
Verifying and assessing directory information and changes.
Synchronising provider directory information with participating systems.
